title: Playboy Magazine August 1972 Sam Peckinpah Interview Girls of Munich Sex Laws
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows toning and soiling with wear and surface creasing along the left edge, plus corner wear and a crease at the right edge. Spine intact. No mailing label. Please review the photos for exact condition. If centerfold presence matters to you, message me before buying and I will check.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, August 1972 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- The Playboy Interview with Sam Peckinpah, in the stretch between "Straw Dogs" and "The Getaway"
- Richard Rhodes reveals the cruelty of American sex laws. Rhodes later won the Pulitzer for "The Making of the Atomic Bomb"
- Senator Philip Hart probes corporate crime
- The Girls of Munich, timed to the Summer Olympics held there that August

Inflatable rabbit cover, shot in the surf.

The back cover carries a 1972 Camel Filters ad, "They're not for everybody," with the Maxine's Massage Parlor gag.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
